description: **Project Name:** Patient-Care Healthcare Management System   **Project Lead:** Er. Amuthan Arries C / Lead T&D   **GitHub:** [amuthanarries](https://github.com/amuthanarries)   **Description:** A comprehensive full-stack web application that enables healthcare providers to manage patient records, schedule appointments, and track medical histories with secure authentication. Features include patient registration, appointment booking, prescription tracking, and role-based access for doctors and staff.   **Technology Stack:** MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js)
